sources.title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures

corrections: Clarified Timsort's use of binary insertion sort for extending short runs.
Separated quicksort average and worst-case recursion space and matched the warning to the fixed-pivot implementation.
Corrected stable counting sort auxiliary space to O(n+k).
Documented that the radix-sort demo only supports non-negative integers.
Corrected heapsort page kind from data-structure to algorithm.
